title: 到最近的人的最大距离
summary: 座位数组中一表示有人、零表示空位，选择空位使到最近人的距离最大，返回该距离。
insight: 两名已坐者之间最长零段的最佳距离是间距的一半；首尾零段只受单侧约束，距离等于整段长度。
pitfalls: 首段和尾段需单独按单侧距离计算

solutions.title: 扫描已占座位间距
solutions.idea: 比较首尾空段和相邻有人座位的中点距离。
steps: previous=-1，扫描每个值一的位置 i
若是第一个有人位置，answer=max(answer,i)，否则 answer=max(answer,(i-previous)/2)

code.java: class Solution { public int maxDistToClosest(int[] seats){int answer=0,previous=-1;for(int i=0;i<seats.length;i++)if(seats[i]==1){answer=previous<0?i:Math.max(answer,(i-previous)/2);previous=i;}return Math.max(answer,seats.length-1-previous);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxDistToClosest(seats:IntArray):Int{var answer=0;var previous=-1;for(i in seats.indices)if(seats[i]==1){answer=if(previous<0)i else maxOf(answer,(i-previous)/2);previous=i};return maxOf(answer,seats.lastIndex-previous)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxDistToClosest(vector<int>& seats){int answer=0,previous=-1;for(int i=0;i<(int)seats.size();++i)if(seats[i]){answer=previous<0?i:max(answer,(i-previous)/2);previous=i;}return max(answer,(int)seats.size()-1-previous);} };
